data.insight: The Company has not been regular in depositing undisputed statutory dues, including GST and Income Tax, with outstanding dues totaling Rs. 1,042.79 Lacs.
data.summary: The company has significant arrears of statutory dues that have not been deposited on time, indicating potential compliance and financial management issues.
data.title: Irregularity in Statutory Dues Payments
data.bare_text: the Company has not been regular in depositing undisputed statutory dues, including Goods and services tax, provident fund, Employees State insurance, Income tax, Sales Tax, duty of Custom, duty of Excise, value Added Tax, Cess and other material statutory dues applicable to it with the appropriate authorities. The arrears of outstanding statutory dues as on the last day of financial year concerned for a period of more than six months from the date they became payable as under : Income Tax Act Tax deducted at source 830.03; Goods and Services Tax Act GST 212.76

data.insight: The Company has a default in repayment of dues to banks totaling Rs. 11,826.01 Lacs in principal and Rs. 5,108.12 Lacs in interest, classified as sub-standard.
data.summary: The significant default in loan repayments raises concerns about the company's liquidity and financial stability.

data.bare_text: The details of default in repayment of dues... to banks, financial institutions, non-banking financial companies... Term Loan YES Bank 11,826.01 5,108.12 Classified as sub-standard on balance sheet date.

data.insight: A going concern warning is implied due to the company's significant financial difficulties, including overdue loans and irregular cash flow management.
data.summary: The financial difficulties pose a serious risk to the company's ability to continue operating as a going concern.
data.title: Going Concern Warning
data.bare_text: The company concluded a few seizable transactions despite the adverse market conditions... The cash flow remained under pressure and impacted the repayments obligations of the Company.
